keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Hamburger SV 1, Borussia M'gladbach 0. Miro Muheim (Hamburger SV) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Albert Sambi Lokonga.
Ko Itakura (Borussia M'gladbach) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Hamburger SV 1, Borussia M'gladbach 1. Robin Hack (Borussia M'gladbach) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joe Scally.
First Half ends, Hamburger SV 1, Borussia M'gladbach 1.
Second yellow card to Ko Itakura (Borussia M'gladbach) for a bad foul.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Kevin Diks replaces Robin Hack.
Goal! Hamburger SV 2, Borussia M'gladbach 1. Shafiq Nandja (Hamburger SV) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Albert Grønbæk.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Alexander Røssing-Lelesiit replaces Shafiq Nandja.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Terem Moffi replaces Martin Adeline.
Goal! Hamburger SV 3, Borussia M'gladbach 1. Albert Grønbæk (Hamburger SV) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury David Møller Wolfe (Hamburger SV).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Yussuf Poulsen replaces Albert Grønbæk.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Kofi Amoako replaces Albert Sambi Lokonga.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Jens Castrop replaces Zento Uno.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Isac Lidberg replaces Shuto Machino.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Franck Honorat replaces Lukas Ullrich.
Substitution, Hamburger SV. Jason Bissi Mouelle replaces Sebastiaan Bornauw.
Jens Castrop (Borussia M'gladbach) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Warmed Omari (Hamburger SV) is shown the yellow card.
